configuration.independent_generation_policy: Only after dev completion and algorithm freeze. One generation request per document, one automatic source-grounding audit per candidate. No answer-performance-based filtering or regeneration. Require exact evidence quotes and all schema/source checks plus audit YES before admitting. Retain rejected candidates and all errors.
configuration.selection_policy: One predeclared policy, no parameter search. Dev verifies constraints and observes performance. Freeze after dev regardless of improvement; do not tune on independent data or outcomes.
configuration.primary_comparison: qp_combined_r30 vs fresh llmlingua2_r30; whole-message estimated and API-reported prompt tokens; macro key-fact accuracy; paired question bootstrap and document-cluster bootstrap
configuration.budget_policy: Use each question's fresh r30 full input as numeric target. Protected spans capped at 35 percent of available context budget; trim residual words then greedily add source units and exact prefixes. No artificial filler; report every deficit/overflow. All ablations share target and repair algorithm.
configuration.claim_policy: Report negative results. No confirmatory population claim from small synthetic dataset, correlated questions, unblinded automatic gold generation/audit or post-hoc subgroup selection. Existing test 139 is not an independent endpoint.

config.selection_protocol: Before new API outcomes: source-check all candidates; exclude suspected judge/gold issues, use distinct qids and clearly inspectable lost literal/entity (A) or missing semantic link with surviving operands (B). Purposeful fixed manifest, not random or representative sampling. Use r30 for all ten to hold compression condition fixed. Classification is source-checked by Codex, not human ground truth; human verification remains pending. Do not revise selection after outcomes.
config.placebo_start: A single Python process uses one CPU core for your code.
config.placebo_rationale: Worker replication, per-process memory and Kubernetes worker configuration do not answer any selected question. Use contiguous verbatim prefix ending at a whitespace boundary, chosen only for nearest total input token budget. No answer-derived filler.
config.insertion: append at end of baseline context, identical two-newline delimiter for placebo and oracle
